# Era Widgets

CSS-first, spec-first UI skins for agents. Canonical API is HTML + ew- classes + data-* attrs.
Set personality with data-era on a root. Do not rewrite markup per era.
Load only needed sections; avoid full-library context.

## Quick start
- CSS: @groovster/css/era-widgets.css
- MCP: list_eras | get_component | validate | recommend
- Rules: generated/rules/era-widgets.mdc

## Eras (cards: generated/llms/era-<id>.card.txt)
- bauhaus: Bauhaus: constructive geometric planes, functional type and disciplined color.
- deco: Jazz-age geometry: stepped edges, vertical emphasis, brass on lacquer.
- earth: Crafted earth tones: clay, moss, sand — quiet organic UI.
- groovy: 70s groove: avocado & harvest gold, soft flares, lazy curves.
- mcm-atomic: 1950s Atomic / Googie: starbursts, atom orbits, kidney Formica, script over caps.
- memphis: Playful postmodern: squiggles, confetti shapes, loud primaries on cream.
- neon: 80s synthwave: perspective grid, striped sunset sun, chrome type, neon tubes.
- neutral: Quiet modern system skin — the default before personality.
- swiss: Swiss: asymmetric typographic grids, objective clarity, measured red accents.

## Fidelity & ornament
- Bands: `whisper|standard|costume` (costume default; `default`/`signature` → standard).
- Neon and Atomic costume use `.ew-hero__stage`; see era cards.
- Deco uses `.ew-hero__panel`; FIDELITY.md defines bands.

## Recipes (cards: generated/llms/recipe-<id>.card.txt)
commerce, dashboard, editorial, event, hospitality. Composition, not a new era.

## Rules
- Prefer native elements. Zero attrs = defaults. Glow ≠ contrast.
- Published CSS/JS must import nothing.
